The strategy employs a Donchian channel breakout system on 5-minute session bars across a diversified multi-asset universe (crypto, equities, gold, metals, energy). Signals are filtered by a 4-hour EMA(55)/EMA(200) trend filter and sized via risk-percentage position sizing at 3.0x notional exposure. Overlays include a drawdown governor (15%/25% triggers), a VIX/Fear-Greed regime proxy, per-asset daily EMA-200 quarter-sizing, and a breakout conviction boost.

The backtest was audited for forward-looking bias — all signals use completed bars, entries fill at next-bar open with slippage, and overlay lookups apply 1-day lags. No look-ahead bias was detected.

8.3 Methodology Notes

  • All backtests use 5-minute bar data from Binance (crypto) and Tiingo (equities/metals/energy).
  • Entries execute at the next bar's open price with slippage applied.
  • Per-asset signals are generated independently; portfolio allocation occurs chronologically.
  • Monte Carlo simulations use i.i.d. bootstrapping from the empirical trade P&L distribution.
  • Sharpe/Sortino ratios are annualised using observed trades-per-year (~133).
  • VaR/CVaR are computed at the individual trade level relative to portfolio equity at entry.
